name: 12449 · Lake Katrine, NY
findings: ZIP 12449 (Lake Katrine) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12449 (Lake Katrine) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12449 (Lake Katrine) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
